corrections.text: The title and the Overview say Cursor and Antigravity each "added" voice calls on November 6, 2026. That is the date of Cursor's changelog entry; for Antigravity, The New Stack says Google "announced Voice mode" that day and 9to5Google says Google is "rolling out a big update to Antigravity this week", and neither says the feature became available to users on November 6.

Google's own Antigravity changelog, which the article does not cite, lists Voice mode in version 2.29.0, dated November 3, 2026, as "rolling out gradually, so you may not see it yet", and in version 2.30.0, dated November 9, 2026, as having "finished rolling out" to everyone except business and enterprise accounts.
